unestablished.marker:
ordo.evangelium.munda-cor-meum

The state of this unit after this act is NOT ESTABLISHED.
It is not carried forward from the inherited state, because carrying it
forward would assert that nothing changed.

THE PRAYER IS IN BOTH BOOKS AND ITS STATE IS STILL NOT ESTABLISHED, which is
what `unrecorded` is for.

An accent-normalised search of 1970-missale-romanum-typica for `munda cor meum
ac labia mea` returns the prayer at lines 21303 and 26387 [verified], so it
survived. But the 1962 unit here was read from a CROSS-REFERENCE -- the Benziger
book prints `Munda cor meum, ut supra` at this point and the prayer itself
stands earlier -- so this file has never read the 1962 words. Two texts cannot be
compared when one of them was not read, and carrying the unit forward unchanged
would assert an identity nobody established.

So the unit leaves the liturgy at this station and a marker takes its place. The
fix is cheap and is not guesswork: read the Munda cor meum where the 1962 book
actually prints it.

parasceve.orationes.pro-iudaeis-invitatorium

The state of this unit after this act is NOT ESTABLISHED.
It is not carried forward from the inherited state, because carrying it
forward would assert that nothing changed.

The witnesses differ and the act is not established. The pre-1955 books print
`Oremus et pro perfidis Judaeis` (missale-romanum-1920 36442, pustet-1862
32769-32770); the 1962 witness prints `Oremus et pro Iudaeis` under a numbered
title `8. PRO CONVERSIONE IUDAEORUM` (benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 39247, 39252),
and a whole-file search of it for `perfid` returns nothing. The removal is
commonly attributed to John XXIII in 1959; no instrument for it was found in
this corpus and none is asserted from memory, so no station carries it and the
unit's state after this act is not established rather than assumed unchanged.

parasceve.orationes.pro-iudaeis-oratio

The state of this unit after this act is NOT ESTABLISHED.
It is not carried forward from the inherited state, because carrying it
forward would assert that nothing changed.

Same case, same missing instrument. The 1962 witness prints `Omnipotens
sempiterne Deus, qui Iudaeos etiam a tua misericordia non repellis`
(benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 39281-39284) where the pre-1955 books print `qui
etiam judaicam perfidiam a tua misericordia non repellis`.

parasceve.orationes.pro-iudaeis-rubrica

The state of this unit after this act is NOT ESTABLISHED.
It is not carried forward from the inherited state, because carrying it
forward would assert that nothing changed.

Same case again, and the third face of it. The pre-1955 rubric forbids the
kneeling that every other solemn prayer has; the 1962 witness prints `Oremus.
Flectamus genua. Levate.` at benziger-iuxta-typicam-1962 39279 and carries no
such rubric. The two pre-1955 witnesses also disagree with each other about the
rubric's wording, with no act between them, which is why this unit could not be
established even before the 1962 witness was read.
